parameters.name: NoCandidateAPFailures
parameters.description: Number of times this Associated Device should have been steered but wasn't because a better candidate AP couldn't be found.

parameters.name: BlacklistAttempts
parameters.description: Number of times a Blacklist steer was attempted on this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BlacklistSuccesses
parameters.description: Number of times an attempted Blacklist steer succeeded for this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BlacklistFailures
parameters.description: Number of times an attempted Blacklist steer failed for this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BTMAttempts
parameters.description: Number of times a BTM (BSS Transition Management; {{bibref|802.11k}}) steer was attempted on this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BTMSuccesses
parameters.description: Number of times an attempted BTM (BSS Transition Management; {{bibref|802.11k}}) steer succeeded for this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BTMFailures
parameters.description: Number of times an attempted BTM (BSS Transition Management; {{bibref|802.11k}}) steer failed for this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BTMQueryResponses
parameters.description: Number of asynchronous BTM (BSS Transition Management; {{bibref|802.11k}}) Queries for which a BTM Request was issued to this Associated Device.

parameters.name: LastSteerTime
parameters.description: The number of {{units}} since this Associated Device was last attempted to be steered.

object.description: The summary of statistics related to Multi-AP Steering for this STA on the Wi-Fi network. The counters contained in {{object}} are all reset on reboot.
